title: When the Thorn Sings
author: Vesper Almeida
blurb: Beatrix Marchetti, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
